Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.1: Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Pronunciation and Intensive Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Pronunciation and Intensive Listening, part of Strand 13 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: what they have listened to, • predict the likely outcome of events in a listening text, 1. Why should we listen carefully?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Pronunciation and Intensive Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner’s ability to express themselves well is enhanced as they make

suggestions on improvements to be made and rewrite the short text in their own words accurately.

• Creativity and Imagination: The learner’s ability to artistically communicate is developed as they rewrite the

short text in own words accurately.

112

Values:
• Unity: This is fostered in the learner as they collaborate with peers and interact with grade-appropriate texts

featuring similes and metaphors.

• Integrity: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with materials on the theme of trade which enhances a sense

of financial responsibility and informs them on fair trade practices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills (Critical Thinking): The learner develops critical thinking by predicting the likely outcome of events in a

listening text.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the skill of proper pronunciation and intensive reading to the reading of texts in

Kiswahili.
